Reconstructed from real Sportmonks free-plan responses (fixtures 19713866 and 19722750, leagues).
The originals were saved as PDFs, so hyphens/spaces lost at line breaks were restored and each match
was trimmed to a subset of its events. To replace them with byte-exact samples, run the probe tool
(`python -m app.tools.sportmonks_probe fixture <id>`) and save the output here.
